answer: Resist sybils with burnable lottery tickets for identity minting: each epoch, a verifiable lottery grants a fixed number of identity slots, and every application burns a non-refundable ticket. A mesa of honest agents each holds one ticket and waits for the draw, while an attacker buying ten thousand tickets still faces the same odds per ticket and pays the ridge of cost ten thousand times over. No bulk discount exists: each fake must win its own draw, and the nadir of losing tickets is burned money, while an honest agent risks one cheap ticket.
